---
title: Mitten pattern template
description: Reusable Markdown template for writing and sharing knit or crochet mitten patterns with sections for sizing, gauge, materials, and step-by-step directions for cuff, hand, thumb gusset, and thumb

Use this reusable template to write and share your knit or crochet mitten patterns in Markdown. Fill in the bracketed sections with your pattern details. This template works for fingerless mitts, full mittens, and thumb gusset constructions.
